_comment: Was MODIFY_ATTACK on the current attack. A plain STATIC is dispatched by nothing and MODIFY_ATTACK buffs the CURRENT attack, of which there is none when a non-attack action resolves — so this did not merely apply too broadly, it did not run. MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK is the one-shot: consumed by the first matching attack, expiring with the turn if unused. The second clause used MAY_DESTROY_SILVERS_TO_EQUIP — another card's bespoke effect — for 'you may destroy an aura you control'.
